File convert · In development

File converter

Images, PDFs, data and text, converted on your device.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

File convert has these main features: iPhone HEIC, camera RAW and images to JPG, PNG, WebP and PDF; PDF to images, Word and Excel; merge and split. It opens Any image, PDF, CSV, JSON, Markdown, Plain text.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with File convert

  • Convert a PDF to Word (DOCX)
  • Convert a PDF to Excel (XLSX)
  • Convert a PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX)
  • Convert AVIF to JPG
  • Convert an ICS calendar to CSV
  • Convert XML to JSON
  • A free CloudConvert alternative that stays on your device
  • 3D file converter
  • Convert a 3D model to STL for printing
  • Open an SIE file online
  • Convert an SIE file to Excel
  • Convert OFX to Excel
  • Convert MT940 to Excel
  • View a camt.053 bank statement
  • DNG converter: RAW photos to JPG, PNG or WebP
